concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-top-up-balance-accounts]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service recurring direct-debit funding overview for balance accounts, with fixed/target amounts, account-timezone trigger checks and bank-instrument source; linked setup/status guides govern consent, capability and credited-funds evidence.
warnings: The overview compresses outgoing direct-debit request into incoming transfer/balance increase. The linked creation and webhook guides distinguish setup, trigger, transfer state, credited transaction and later rejection/return; they also expose an exact-threshold wording difference and sample direction discrepancy.
